I don't think we want to guarantee the order of these calls. The `ISerializationListener` interface is meant to be internal anyway[^1].

We explicitly sort the C# scripts in inheritance dependency order:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9f68a816599412c56a4626dd6c47244ebc65ed1f/modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp#L671

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9f68a816599412c56a4626dd6c47244ebc65ed1f/modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp#L548-L568

This ensures the base types are reloaded before the derived types.

If you absolutely need your deserialization code to follow a specific order, using a stack to sort them on your end, as you mentioned, sounds like a good approach to me. It should provide you with the control you need in your specific use case.

[^1]: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/issues/10615#issuecomment-2635063398
